_comment: HintWise Studio catalog (see build.js, studio section). implemented.json says which apps exist; this file adds the public name, a one-line blurb, the audiences used by the Apps filters, and apps built outside the daily-ideas routine (entries with a url). An app in implemented.json with no entry here still appears, with its audience guessed from the idea category and its blurb from publicNotes.

audiences.label: Small businesses
audiences.blurb: Shops, clinics, charities, makers and the people who run their websites.

audiences.label: Developers
audiences.blurb: Software teams, web agencies and anyone who ships code.

audiences.label: Learners
audiences.blurb: Students and the curious: interactive lessons, puzzles and games.

accessibility-fleet-log.title: Accessibility Fleet Log
accessibility-fleet-log.blurb: For agencies looking after many client sites: everyone's accessibility status on one screen, a dated log of problems found and fixed, a statement per site and a monthly report under your name.

accessibility-lens.title: Accessibility Lens
accessibility-lens.blurb: Scan a public page against WCAG 2.1, then see it the way low-vision, color-blind, keyboard-only and screen-reader users do.

acr-draft.title: ACR Draft
acr-draft.blurb: Write the accessibility report (VPAT) a university asks for before it buys your software: scans plus a guided review, exported to Word.

agent-blast-radius.title: Agent Blast Radius
agent-blast-radius.blurb: Drop in MCP configs and agent settings to see what each AI tool on your machine can reach.

assignment-stress-test.title: Assignment Stress Test
assignment-stress-test.blurb: Every output the scheduler could produce for a fork/wait snippet, and why the others are impossible.

bombe-bench.title: Bombe Bench
bombe-bench.blurb: Step through an Enigma rotor by rotor, then break it with a working Bombe.
bombe-bench.featuredBlurb: An Enigma you can open up, and a working Turing-Welchman Bombe that breaks messages from a guessed word.

brocot-gear-finder.title: Brocot Gear Finder
brocot-gear-finder.blurb: Gear trains for any ratio with continued fractions and the Stern-Brocot tree.

cache-miss-theater.title: Cache Miss Theater
cache-miss-theater.blurb: Watch a C loop nest's exact address trace run through a configurable cache.
cache-miss-theater.featuredBlurb: Watch a C loop's memory accesses run through a cache you configure, with every miss labelled.

chess-td.title: Chess TD
chess-td.blurb: Run a chess tournament from your browser, even offline: Swiss and round-robin pairings by FIDE and US Chess rules, results by keyboard, standings with tiebreaks.
chess-td.description: Run a chess tournament from your browser, even offline. Swiss and round-robin pairings follow FIDE and US Chess rules, each pairing comes with an explanation, results go in by keyboard, and standings come with tiebreaks.

cipher-ladder.title: Cipher Ladder
cipher-ladder.blurb: Climb from Caesar to Vigenère to homophonic ciphers with live cryptanalysis tools.

code-analogy-forge.title: Code Analogy Forge
code-analogy-forge.blurb: Three analogies for a piece of code or a CS concept, pitched at the audience you choose.

code-review-gauntlet.title: Code Review Gauntlet
code-review-gauntlet.blurb: Race the clock to spot planted bugs and security holes.

code-viva.title: Code Viva
code-viva.blurb: Short oral checks on each student's own submission, with questions anchored to their functions.

consent-leak-watch.title: Consent Leak Watch
consent-leak-watch.blurb: Check that your shop's cookie banner really blocks trackers, and which plugin broke it.

cron-cartographer.title: Cron Cartographer
cron-cartographer.blurb: Any cron expression, RRULE or GitHub Actions schedule as a calendar heatmap of when it fires.

data-structure-city.title: Data Structure City
data-structure-city.blurb: A hash map, B-tree, skip list and LRU cache side by side, driven by one Redis-like console.

diagram-layout-engine.title: Diagram Layout Engine
diagram-layout-engine.blurb: A from-scratch layout engine for Mermaid flowcharts, with every stage of the pipeline visible.

digital-student-assistant.title: Digital Student Assistant
digital-student-assistant.blurb: An AI teaching assistant that asks before it tells and won’t hand over homework. Yusuf Pisan’s data structures students at UW Bothell use it now.
digital-student-assistant.description: Digital Student Assistant is the AI teaching assistant for data structures courses at UW Bothell, and students are using it now. It guides rather than answers: it asks before it tells, it will not hand over homework solutions, and it teaches from the instructor’s own lectures and recordings rather than the internet. To look around, sign in with the demo account demo@hintwise.org (no code needed); student accounts are limited to UW addresses for now.

donation-receipts.title: Donation Receipts
donation-receipts.blurb: For small charities, churches and community groups: numbered donation receipts with your ABN and the right tax wording, and one 30 June statement per donor, straight from your Xero or bank export.

dossier-comment-reflector.title: Dossier Comment Reflector
dossier-comment-reflector.blurb: Years of student evaluation comments in; themes, before-and-after evidence for your course changes, fair quotes and a page-limited tenure reflection draft out.

edit-graph-lab.title: Edit Graph Lab
edit-graph-lab.blurb: Diff as a shortest-path search, with Myers' algorithm animated.

elevator-algorithm-lab.title: Elevator Algorithm Lab
elevator-algorithm-lab.blurb: Write an elevator dispatch policy in JavaScript and run it against seeded traffic.

fork-count.title: Fork Count
fork-count.blurb: Every process, pipe and possible output of a fork/wait/pipe C snippet, deadlocks included.

game-palette-inspector.title: Game Palette Inspector
game-palette-inspector.blurb: Check a palette against WCAG contrast and 8 kinds of color blindness, with replacements that keep the art style.

gpu-parallel-puzzler.title: GPU Parallel Puzzler
gpu-parallel-puzzler.blurb: Twelve kernel puzzles on a simulated GPU: warps, divergence, coalescing, bank conflicts.

har-detective.title: HAR Detective
har-detective.blurb: Drag in a browser HAR file for a waterfall and a ranked, plain-English performance report.

health-page-tracker-watch.title: Health Page Tracker Watch
health-page-tracker-watch.blurb: For therapists, clinics, med spas and wellness studios: every outside tool on your booking, intake and service pages, what it receives, whether its maker signs a BAA, and what is new since last month.

heap-arena-replay.title: Heap Arena Replay
heap-arena-replay.blurb: Replay a malloc/free trace on a word-accurate heap under different allocator policies.

leap-second-lab.title: Leap Second Lab
leap-second-lab.blurb: TAI, UTC, GPS, Unix and UT1 on one timeline, and what 23:59:60 does to your code.

letter-ledger.title: Letter Ledger
letter-ledger.blurb: Recommendation-letter requests: a request link with your policy and FERPA release, encrypted packets, a deadline dashboard.

lockstep-lab.title: Lockstep Lab
lockstep-lab.blurb: Watch deterministic lockstep and rollback netcode work, and fail.

migration-diff-narrator.title: Migration Diff Narrator
migration-diff-narrator.blurb: Two versions of a schema in, every change marked safe, caution or breaking out.

misrepresentation-preflight.title: Misrepresentation Preflight
misrepresentation-preflight.blurb: Suspended by Google Shopping for “Misrepresentation”? See every place your store contradicts itself (contact details, shipping and return times, prices, your feed) before your next review request.

modulo-bias-microscope.title: Modulo Bias Microscope
modulo-bias-microscope.blurb: Paste a random sampling function and see exactly how biased it is.

mult-streak.title: Mult Streak
mult-streak.blurb: Ten multiplications in a row wins a 24-hour crown.

mychessmaster.title: MyChessMaster
mychessmaster.blurb: For tournament players preparing for a specific opponent: where games went wrong, why, and drills from your own mistakes.
mychessmaster.description: A chess coach for tournament players preparing for a specific opponent. It finds where each of your games went wrong, explains why, and turns your own mistakes into preparation sheets and spaced-repetition drills.

net-units.title: Net Units
net-units.blurb: Measure how much code a change adds in syntax-level units instead of lines.

outguess-me.title: Outguess Me
outguess-me.blurb: Press F or J as randomly as you can while an oracle predicts you. You are less random than you think.

pathfinding-playground.title: Pathfinding Playground
pathfinding-playground.blurb: Draw a grid and race BFS, Dijkstra, A* and friends across it.

pluck-lab.title: Pluck Lab
pluck-lab.blurb: A keyboard guitar synthesized live by Karplus-Strong, with the filter on screen.

poincare-paint.title: Poincaré Paint
poincare-paint.blurb: Draw in the hyperbolic disk and watch every stroke tile to infinity.
poincare-paint.featuredBlurb: Draw in the hyperbolic disk and watch every stroke tile to infinity, the way Escher’s Circle Limit prints do.

popup-check.title: Popup Check
popup-check.blurb: A free bookmark that tests your email popup, age gate, cookie banner and chat button with the keyboard and a screen-reader view, and keeps a dated report with a message for the app’s support.

program-alarm-1202.title: Program Alarm 1202
program-alarm-1202.blurb: A playable model of the Apollo Guidance Computer's executive during the lunar descent.

prompt-genome.title: Prompt Genome
prompt-genome.blurb: Split a prompt into color-coded parts (role, task, constraint, format...) and lint it.

prompt-shrink-ray.title: Prompt Shrink Ray
prompt-shrink-ray.blurb: Compress an LLM prompt with a live token estimate and a check that the keywords survived.

pull-the-pin.title: Pull the Pin
pull-the-pin.blurb: An 8-bit SAP-1 computer where the instructor breaks a chip and students find the fault.

repo-weight-map.title: Repo Weight Map
repo-weight-map.blurb: Drop a project folder in and see what is bloating it, with the .gitignore lines to fix it.

reverse-minesweeper-studio.title: Reverse Minesweeper Studio
reverse-minesweeper-studio.blurb: Paint a picture with mines and find out if it can be solved without guessing.

schema-storyteller.title: Schema Storyteller
schema-storyteller.blurb: Paste a SQL, Prisma or JSON schema, get the data model in plain English plus missing keys and indexes.

shortcut-sprint.title: Shortcut Sprint
shortcut-sprint.blurb: Spaced-repetition drills for keyboard shortcuts in VS Code, Vim, Figma, Excel and more.

sound-sketchpad.title: Sound Sketchpad
sound-sketchpad.blurb: Describe a sound effect in words and get playable audio with WAV export.

sql-replay.title: SQL Replay
sql-replay.blurb: Watch a SELECT execute step by step, each stage narrated.

state-space-atlas.title: State Space Atlas
state-space-atlas.blurb: Every reachable state of Hanoi, sliding tiles, Klotski and Rush Hour, drawn as one graph.

stepwise.title: StepWise
stepwise.blurb: 100+ data structures and algorithms, every step narrated with its pseudocode line and variables; step back, share as a link, embed in Canvas.
stepwise.description: Pick any of more than 100 data structures and algorithms used in university courses, run operations on it, and every step comes with a plain explanation, the pseudocode line that is running and the variables. Step backwards as far as you like, share what you built as a link, or embed it in Canvas.
stepwise.featuredBlurb: 100+ data structures and algorithms for university courses, one narrated step at a time. Step back, share as a link, embed in Canvas.

student-journey-check.title: Student Journey Check
student-journey-check.blurb: A test student walks your online course after every update and tells you which step your students would get stuck on.

study-buddy-matchmaker.title: Study Buddy Matchmaker
study-buddy-matchmaker.blurb: Upload a gradebook CSV and get complementary study pairs with shared agendas.

summit-navigator.title: Summit Navigator
summit-navigator.blurb: A conference program you can use in a hallway: day tabs, track filters, search, a starred personal agenda and a now-and-next banner in your own time zone.

tamerlane-board.title: Tamerlane Board
tamerlane-board.blurb: Timur's 14th-century chess with giraffes, war engines and citadels.

tetromino-arcade.title: Tetromino Arcade
tetromino-arcade.blurb: A falling-block puzzle game with modern rules, seven modes, a computer opponent, replays and a daily challenge.

tiny-brains-league.title: Tiny Brains League
tiny-brains-league.blurb: Train the smallest Connect Four network you can and climb a ladder.

type-witness.title: Type Witness
type-witness.blurb: Watch the TypeScript compiler infer types, expression by expression.

ui-diff-lens.title: UI Diff Lens
ui-diff-lens.blurb: Two screenshots in, every changed region classified as layout, spacing, color, text and so on.

us-duty-price-sheet.title: US Duty Price Sheet
us-duty-price-sheet.blurb: For UK makers who post to US customers duty paid: a US code for every product, a US price and postage table with the duty included, and a list of which prices to change when US duty changes.

where-does-it-say.title: Where Does It Say
where-does-it-say.blurb: Questions about the syllabus answered only with verbatim quotes, or a refusal.

paste-md.title: PasteMD
paste-md.blurb: Paste Markdown or upload a Word file and get a link to share, with an optional password.
paste-md.description: PasteMD turns Markdown into a page you can share. Sign in with Google or an emailed link, paste Markdown or upload a .md or Word (.docx) file, and get a public link; each post can have its own password. A dashboard lists your posts, and scripts can post through its API.

upvoteme.title: UpvoteMe
upvoteme.blurb: Private threads shared by link: people comment, attach files and upvote the comments that matter. No account needed to start one.
upvoteme.description: UpvoteMe gives you an unlisted topic that only people with its link can find. Participants comment, attach files and vote comments up or down; a separate admin link lets you lock comments or delete the topic. Voting can require sign-in (Google or an emailed link) so you can see who voted. Topics are deleted after 30 days without activity.
